name: Tannu Tuva (Tuvan People's Republic, 1933–1939)
description: A red field bearing the state emblem: a golden ring enclosing a mounted herder galloping toward a rising sun, above the letters 'TAR'.
history: Flag of the Tuvan People's Republic (Tannu Tuva), the nominally independent Soviet-aligned state between Russia and Mongolia, famous for its diamond- and triangle-shaped postage stamps; annexed by the USSR in 1944.

features.role: emblem with horseman, rising sun and 'TAR'
